location_exception_reason: Prefabricated industrial buildings are engineered structures sold on structural performance (clear-span, load capacity, wind/seismic compliance) and turnkey delivery capability, not geographic origin. Location in titles is redundant — buyer filters already expose seller location independently.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Contractor', 'EPC') describe who is selling, not what is being sold. The product is a prefabricated building system regardless of seller classification; IndiaMART's business-type filter already surfaces this distinction to buyers. Removing these words leaves the product meaning unchanged.
